value.rationale: The perfect-matching vectors of K8 are a canonical symmetric nonbipartite frequency orbit. The sharp endpoint Fourier projection norm equals a natural mean absolute signed hafnian. The complete exact 23-level law on the 28-dimensional binary edge group is not implied by cardinality/Parseval or the known bipartite permanent statistics, and is a motivated natural finite classification with a stand-alone exact first absolute moment and zero-free support. No general theorem is required for the precise finite invariant.
